horizon.processing_notes: Coordinate-driven coordinate-terrain-1. Airless body-centre visibility from one fixed observer; exact spherical curvature. Search extent: per-ray global-height stopping rule, bound 10873.0 m above 1737.4 km sphere. Source priority and bilinear valid-pixel selection from registry. No missing terrain replaced by zero. Radial and source-resolution limitations are in checks. Mesh never controls Horizon-view visibility.

radial_convergence.note: Every radial segment halved at 36 azimuths on the same DEM; not absolute terrain accuracy; first sample remains 5 m.

limitations: Source coordinates/frames retain their documented assumptions.
Global LDEM_64 is coarse distant terrain only; grid spacing varies with latitude. No fine obstacles are resolved.
